rules.text: Purchases made October 4, 2026 – December 30, 2026 are eligible for return through January 31, 2027 for most Kohl's merchandise.
rules.quote: Purchases made **October 4, 2026 – December 30, 2026** are eligible for return through **January 31, 2027**.

rules.text: Sephora at Kohl’s purchases made October 30, 2026 – December 30, 2026 are eligible for return through January 31, 2027.
rules.quote: Purchases made at **Sephora at Kohl’s** between **October 30, 2026 – December 30, 2026** are eligible for return through **January 31, 2027**.

rules.text: Most Kohl’s merchandise can be returned up to 90 days from the date of purchase.
rules.quote: Most Kohl’s merchandise can be returned up to **90 days** from the date of purchase.

rules.text: Kohl’s Cardholders enjoy up to 120 days to return most items.
rules.quote: Kohl’s Cardholders enjoy **up to 120 days** to return most items.

rules.text: Premium Electronics and Watches normally have a 30-day return window.
rules.quote: Premium Electronics and Watches normally have a **30-day** return window.

rules.text: Sephora at Kohl’s products follow the Sephora standard 30-day return policy.
rules.quote: Sephora at Kohl’s products follow the Sephora standard 30-day return policy.

rules.category: opened or unsealed breast pumps and accessories
rules.text: Opened or Unsealed Breast Pumps and Accessories are non-refundable and cannot be exchanged.
rules.quote: Opened or Unsealed **Breast Pumps and Accessories**: Non-refundable and cannot be exchanged.

rules.text: Most returns are accepted with or without a receipt; associates can look up your order using order number, Kohl’s Rewards account, credit card number, or return barcode in the Kohl’s App.
rules.quote:
Most returns are accepted with or without a receipt. Associates can look up your order using:

*   Order number
*   Kohl’s Rewards account
*   Credit card number
*   Return barcode in the Kohl’s App

rules.text: Refunds will be issued to the card used to make your purchase; merchandise credits mailed to billing address unless otherwise specified.
rules.quote: Refunds will be issued to the card used to make your purchase. Merchandise credits will be mailed to the billing address on file, unless a different address is provided.

rules.text: Refunds from in-store returns should appear on your credit card within about seven days, but may take longer depending on your bank’s processing time.
rules.quote: Your refund should appear on your credit card within about seven days, but it may take longer depending on your bank’s processing time.

rules.text: Most items are eligible for in-store exchanges within the applicable return window; exchanges by mail are not available.
rules.quote: Most items are eligible for in-store exchanges within the applicable return window. Exchanges by mail are not available.
